dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductive container type whose values package ten real components; the constructor and projection dependencies determine their order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target universally quantifies a value tr of this type and uses its ten real components as th, tl, s1, a2, a3, a4, s2, t, r, and s3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the fourth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is a2, used in s1+a2=x1*th, P(a2), the exact sum a2+a3, and the exact difference s2-a2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the fifth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is a3, used in a3+a4=x1*tl, the exact sum a2+a3, and the exact difference a3-t.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the sixth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is a4, used in a3+a4=x1*tl and the final exact sum r+a4.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the ninth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is r, the nearest representable value to a3-t and an input to the exact sum r+a4.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the third real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is s1, used in s1+a2=x1*th and in the final sum (s1+s2)+s3.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the seventh real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is s2, assumed nearest representable to a2+a3, used in the exact difference s2-a2, and used in the final sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the tenth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is s3, assumed nearest representable to r+a4 and used in the final sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the eighth real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is t, assumed nearest representable to s2-a2 and used in the exact difference a3-t.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the first real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is th, used in th+tl=x2*x3 and s1+a2=x1*th.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection selecting the second real component of a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For tr this is tl, used in th+tl=x2*x3 and a3+a4=x1*tl.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a predicate P and reals e and q, LocalDef012 P e q means P(q) and, for every real candidate c, P(c) implies |e-q| <= |e-c|. Thus q is an absolute-error minimizer among all P-representable reals for the exact value e.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies that s2 minimizes error for a2+a3, t minimizes error for s2-a2, r minimizes error for a3-t, and s3 minimizes error for r+a4; each such condition also asserts representability of the corresponding result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor taking ten real arguments and producing a LocalDef001 value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the projection bodies, it fixes the component order as th, tl, s1, a2, a3, a4, s2, t, r, s3. The target does not construct a trace or assert that one exists.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Exact equality between two values of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the three exact decomposition hypotheses and the exact final equality, with no approximation or tolerance.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The binary addition operation extracted from an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiated with the real-number addition instance, every occurrence denotes ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The binary multiplication operation extracted from an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiated with the real-number multiplication instance, every occurrence denotes ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The binary subtraction operation extracted from an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Instantiated with real subtraction, it forms s2-a2, a3-t, and the error differences in the nearest-representable relation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All data, trace components, candidates, exact expressions, errors, sums, products, and differences are real scalars.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the addition used by every instantiated HAdd expression.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the multiplication used in x2*x3, x1*th, x1*tl, and (x1*x2)*x3.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real subtraction defined by a-b = a+(-b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all exact residuals and all differences whose absolute values measure approximation error.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical conversion of an Add operation into a homogeneous HAdd operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects Real.instAdd to HAdd.hAdd, so the syntactic heterogeneous additions in the target are ordinary real sums.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical conversion of a Mul operation into a homogeneous HMul operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects Real.instMul to HMul.hMul, so the syntactic heterogeneous multiplications in the target are ordinary real products.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical conversion of a Sub operation into a homogeneous HSub operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects Real.instSub to HSub.hSub, so the syntactic heterogeneous subtractions in the target are ordinary real differences.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Inside LocalDef012 it requires both that the proposed rounded value is representable and that its error is no larger than every representable candidate's error.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real ordering, it compares absolute errors in each nearest-representable condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive-group structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real negation and additive structure needed by the absolute-value definition used for error magnitudes.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal ordering on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each LocalDef012 error comparison the ordinary real inequality |e-q| <= |e-c|.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard lattice structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the maximum operation used to define real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In a lattice-ordered additive group, abs(a) is max(a,-a); on the reals this is the ordinary absolute value |a|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the absolute difference between each exact value and either its proposed result or any representable candidate.

binders: An arbitrary predicate P := representable on the real numbers.
Arbitrary real numbers x1, x2, and x3.
An arbitrary trace tr with ten real components, written in constructor order as (th, tl, s1, a2, a3, a4, s2, t, r, s3).
hypotheses: s2 is P-representable and minimizes |(a2+a3)-c| over all P-representable real candidates c.
t is P-representable and minimizes |(s2-a2)-c| over all P-representable real candidates c.
r is P-representable and minimizes |(a3-t)-c| over all P-representable real candidates c.
s3 is P-representable and minimizes |(r+a4)-c| over all P-representable real candidates c.
mathematical_definitions: The trace projections are th=tr.1, tl=tr.2, s1=tr.3, a2=tr.4, a3=tr.5, a4=tr.6, s2=tr.7, t=tr.8, r=tr.9, and s3=tr.10.
For a predicate P and real numbers e and q, define Nearest_P(e,q) to mean P(q) and, for every real c, P(c) implies |e-q| <= |e-c|.
All additions, subtractions, multiplications, inequalities, equalities, and absolute values are the standard operations and relations on real numbers.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every predicate P on the reals, every three real inputs x1, x2, x3, and every ten-real trace (th, tl, s1, a2, a3, a4, s2, t, r, s3), suppose th and tl exactly decompose x2*x3, s1 and a2 exactly decompose x1*th, and a3 and a4 exactly decompose x1*tl. Suppose a2 is P-representable; s2 is a nearest P-representable value to the exact sum a2+a3; the exact residual s2-a2 is P-representable and t is nearest to it; the exact residual a3-t is P-representable and r is nearest to it; and the exact sum r+a4 is P-representable and s3 is nearest to it. Then the exact equality (s1+s2)+s3=(x1*x2)*x3 holds.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: P is an arbitrary predicate on real numbers. The proposition does not encode a floating-point format, radix, precision, exponent range, unit roundoff, closure property, overflow, underflow, NaNs, infinities, or signed zeros.
Nearest representability means only global minimization of absolute real error. Ties are permitted, and no deterministic tie-breaking or rounding function is specified.
The proposition assumes the required minimizers and trace components; it does not assert that such values or such a trace exist.
Because the result is a conditional implication, it is vacuously true whenever any decomposition, representability, or nearest-value hypothesis is unsatisfiable.
The initial condition on s2 does not force s2=a2+a3 because P(a2+a3) is not assumed. Using the candidate a2, it only entails the bound |(a2+a3)-s2| <= |a3| in addition to P(s2).

The explicit assumptions P(s2-a2), P(a3-t), and P(r+a4), together with their nearest-value hypotheses, force t=s2-a2, r=a3-t, and s3=r+a4, respectively, because each exact value is an available zero-error candidate.
Consequently, the hypotheses P(a2) and Nearest_P(a2+a3,s2) are logically unnecessary for deriving the stated final equality from the remaining assumptions.
All quantities are real scalars. No vectors, matrices, dimensions, or norms occur; the only magnitude measure is ordinary real absolute value.
The three product-splitting equalities and all representability facts are assumptions, not consequences of an encoded algorithm.
